description: This file defines an Angular component called NotesLayoutComponent, which manages the sidebar and main content area for notes, including functionality for searching, navigation, and authentication handling.

classes.name: NotesLayoutComponent
classes.description: An Angular standalone component providing the layout for notes, including a sidebar, search functionality, and navigation controls.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Lifecycle hook that initializes the component, checking authentication and loading notes.

methods.name: loadNotes
methods.description: Fetches notes using the NotesService, updating the component's notes signal.

methods.name: onSearchChange
methods.description: Updates the search query signal and reloads the notes based on the new query.

methods.name: newNote
methods.description: Navigates the user to the 'new note' creation page.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out the user and redirects to the login page.
